title: Slay the Spire 2: For Your Consideration
author: demileaf
contents:
It's awards season, Slayers, and the 2026 Steam Awards nominations are open!

Throughout [i]Slay the Spire 2[/i]'s development, before and after its Early Access launch back in March, one of our biggest goals has been to ensure that the game is as fun and accessible for handheld gamers as possible. So it was incredibly exciting to see that it's officially the [b]#1 top-played game on the Steam Deck in 2026![/b]

If you're one of the many players who have been slaying the Spire on-the-go or on the couch, we'd greatly appreciate it if you nominated us for [b]Best Handheld[/b] at this year's Steam Awards!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971832/8f7022277f5b6bebfa9bb022063d6a335cd17f9a.jpg[/img]

If you're so inclined, take a second to click the little box at the top of this post. Don't forget: nominations close on November 30th at 10AM PT and voting runs from December 17th until January 2nd at 10AM PT.

On a separate but related note...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971832/b45c8d172ec3621a7d614fb7c2be1b62a85cd49e.jpg[/img]
As you may have already heard, [b]Slay the Spire 2 was nominated for Best Sim/Strategy at The Game Awards[/b]! It's a stacked category, but again, if you've enjoyed being a part of the Spire's evolution this year and are excited for everything else it still has in store, we would be honored to [url=https://bit.ly/tgavote]have your vote![/url] Be sure to cast your ballot before December 9th at 6PM PT.

Thank you for your consideration :)
